options.objective: Further offline source and metadata analysis.
options.evidence_gap_addressed: Only gaps that can still be read from files already on disk.
minimum_inputs: Existing source, Compose, requirements, and preserved OCI bytes.
options.potential_side_effects: None expected if writes stay inside a new research directory.
stop_conditions: Any need for network, Docker, or execution.
options.success_criteria: A named local gap is closed from existing bytes.
options.remaining_uncertainties: ABI, libc, wheels, VPS identity, startup, and provenance remain unavailable offline.
options.explicit_user_approval_required: A new offline stage naming the exact files and output directory.

options.objective: Controlled read-only registry or image-layer metadata inspection.
options.evidence_gap_addressed: Installed package revisions, libc identity, and interpreter files inside the verified base image.
minimum_inputs: An explicit layer or metadata allowlist.
options.network_access: Approved registry and storage hosts only.
options.docker_or_runtime_access: No Docker daemon and no container execution.
options.filesystem_effects: Preserve approved metadata or layer bytes under a new research directory.
options.potential_side_effects: Layer downloads are large and must not be followed by extraction into a runtime.
expected_artifacts: Layer metadata records and digest checks.
options.success_criteria: The requested layer or package metadata matches its descriptor.
options.remaining_uncertainties: Application wheels, bot startup, VPS identity, and signatures can remain open.
options.explicit_user_approval_required: A stage-specific approval listing hosts, digests, and whether bytes may be stored.

options.evidence_gap_addressed: Exact candidate versions, wheel tags, artifact hashes, and provenance for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
minimum_inputs: Explicit platform tags stated as assumptions until ABI and libc are measured.
required_permissions: No installation and no lockfile unless separately approved.
options.docker_or_runtime_access: No Docker and no container execution.
options.filesystem_effects: Save metadata and hashes. Do not install into the environment.
options.potential_side_effects: A resolver can select versions the image cannot load if ABI or libc is assumed.
expected_artifacts: Per-platform metadata records and hash lists.
options.success_criteria: Selected artifacts have recorded versions, tags, hashes, and unresolved fields.
options.remaining_uncertainties: Metadata cannot prove the base image libc or a measured SOABI.
options.explicit_user_approval_required: A stage-specific approval naming the index, platform tags, and confirming no install.

options.evidence_gap_addressed: Whether a final image can be produced for one named platform.
required_permissions: Network only if the approved inputs require it.
options.network_access: Only if the approved build plan requires it.
options.docker_or_runtime_access: Docker build for a named platform, without deploying the result.
options.potential_side_effects: A build can consume unpinned dependencies or alter local Docker state.
expected_artifacts: Local image digest and build log.
options.success_criteria: The build completes and its digest is recorded.
options.remaining_uncertainties: A built image is not a production deployment or a live-trading approval.
options.explicit_user_approval_required: A separate build approval after dependency and base-image evidence is sufficient.

options.evidence_gap_addressed: Startup, health, interpreter measurement, and native import behaviour.
minimum_inputs: A candidate image built for a named platform.
required_permissions: Container execution in an isolated environment.
options.network_access: None beyond the approved test fixtures.
options.docker_or_runtime_access: Run the candidate container without the production bot process.
options.potential_side_effects: A test can contact a broker or database if pointed at real services.
expected_artifacts: Measured version, ABI, import, and health logs.
options.success_criteria: The named checks pass or fail on recorded evidence.
options.remaining_uncertainties: Isolated success is not production safety or VPS compatibility.
options.explicit_user_approval_required: A separate runtime-test approval with fixtures and prohibited endpoints.

options.objective: Trusted deployment receiver and rollback readiness assessment.
options.evidence_gap_addressed: VPS architecture, receiver identity, and a restorable artifact.
required_permissions: Read-only receiver inspection and no live trading.
options.network_access: Only approved management endpoints, if any are explicitly listed.
options.docker_or_runtime_access: No bot restart and no deployment.
options.potential_side_effects: An inspection can become a deployment if commands are broadened.
expected_artifacts: Receiver inventory and rollback gap record.
options.success_criteria: The host architecture and rollback artifact are either verified or explicitly absent.
options.remaining_uncertainties: Receiver readiness does not authorise live trading.
options.explicit_user_approval_required: A separate receiver and rollback approval.
